title: Virtual Environment Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Python for Robotics
description: Predict what an import or a pip install does in eight terminal situations while the package lists of system Python and two virtual environments stay in view, then run your own commands. Used in Chapter 1.

educational.topic: Virtual environments, the active environment and pip
learningObjectives: Infer what an import or a pip command does in each of eight terminal situations, given which environment is active and which packages each environment contains, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit a prediction first, then watch a pretend shell run the command against three visible package lists; free exploration follows the eight scenarios
keyQuestions: Which package list does Python look in when you type import?
Where does pip install put a library?
Why can old-project keep numpy 1.26 while arm-lab has numpy 2.1?
commonMisconceptions: pip install installs a library for the whole computer
A library installed in one project environment is available to other projects
The environment folder holds the project code
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed predictions, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Three answer buttons: a, b and c
Next scenario / See score / Try again
